{/* HERO */}
Back to selected work
Leave & WFH Management

From scattered messages to one clear leave workflow.

A centralized leave and work-from-home experience that helps employees understand their balance, submit requests, and track approvals—without searching through emails or messages.

{/* Project details */}
{/* PROBLEM */}

The problem

A leave request existed. Context didn't.

Employees had to rely on emails, WhatsApp, or HR conversations to check their remaining leave, request time off, and find out whether something was approved.

The process worked—but information was scattered across different places.

{/* INSIGHT */}

The problem wasn't applying. It was knowing.

Employees didn't just need a leave form. They needed to know how much they had, what would be deducted, who was approving it, and what happened next.

That shifted the product from a request form to a self-service leave system.

{/* SOLUTION */}

From request-centric to visibility-centric.

I designed one connected workflow that brings the important pieces of the experience together.

{/* Workflow */}
} title="Leave" description="Understand available leave and submit time-off requests." /> } title="WFH" description="Request work-from-home without affecting leave balance." /> } title="Balance" description="See available, used, and upcoming leave at a glance." /> } title="Calendar" description="Understand holidays, weekends, and upcoming requests." /> } title="Approval" description="Understand where each request sits in the approval flow." /> } title="History" description="Review previous requests and their final status." />
{/* EXPERIENCE */}

A clearer path from request to resolution.

} title="Check" description="View leave balance, holidays, and upcoming schedule." /> } title="Request" description="Apply for leave or WFH with dates, reason, and supporting details." /> } title="Review" description="See working days, balance impact, and approval flow before submitting." /> } title="Track" description="Follow approval status and view request history." />
{/* EDGE CASES */}

The happy path isn't the whole experience.

I designed for situations that could otherwise create confusion.

Insufficient balance

Prevent requests that exceed available leave.

Date conflicts

Detect overlapping leave and WFH requests.

Holidays & weekends

Separate non-working days from actual leave.

Approval states

Make pending, approved, rejected, and cancelled requests clear.

WFH vs Leave

Keep WFH separate from leave balance and absence.

{/* TRADE OFFS */}

Show what matters. Hide what doesn't.

The challenge was balancing policy complexity with employee simplicity.

Instead of exposing every HR rule upfront, the interface surfaces the information needed at each decision point while keeping detailed policies and administration behind the appropriate workflows.

{/* LEARNING */}

Good workflow design makes information feel effortless.

The strongest part of the solution wasn't another dashboard or form. It was connecting balance, dates, approvals, notifications, and history into one understandable flow.

When the system answers “What happens next?” clearly, users don't need to ask someone else.

{/* BACK TO WORK */}

Back to work

A self-service workflow for employees.
A centralized system for administrators.
